notes.title: Frogwares Publisher Sale is On Right Now
notes.content:
Hello detectives,

Today is a special day in our offices. As of right now, this moment (well, roughly this moment) our studio is 21 years old. Pretty much, it’s our birthday, and we’re having a party. 

It’s been 21 years of work, commitment, dedication, sweat, moments of tears and also of happiness. We have a whole bank filled with stories and memories from all of these years. Perhaps one day we’ll share them with you over coffee, or a blog post. 

But one thing we have to say today is this. Thank you, yes you!, for all your support, your trust, and for being the best community and fandom we could ever ask for.

On this special occasion, we have prepared a huge sale for all our games just for you. The sale will last from 2nd of August to 16th of August 2021 right here on Steam. Get ready, mark these dates in your calendar, and prepare yourself for an 80% discount! Maybe there’s a game missing from your collection?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/frogwares]Click here to visit the Frogwares Publisher Sale page[/url]

Enjoy the sale, thanks for your continuous support, and speak to you soon!

Your Frogwares Team

notes.title: Сompatibility Patch (Part 2 of 2) released!
notes.content:
Hello again, fellow sleuths!

We're releasing the long-awaited second part of the compatibility patch.

This patch fixes common startup and save issues of our older games running on Windows 10. 

We hope you can continue enjoying our previous games to the fullest with these new fixes.

Take care!
Frogwares team

notes.title: Compatibility Patch (Part 1 of 2) released!
notes.content:
Hey there, detectives!

Get ready to welcome a long-requested compatibility patch! 

This patch switches pre-requisite redistributables to common redistributables for our backcatalog games.

Essentially, this is part one of a two-part patch that is needed to allow us to address compatibility issues of our older games with modern PCs.

Second patch, actually fixing the compatibility issues, is coming in early May 2021.

Enjoy!
Frogwares team

notes.title: Frogwares games soundtracks are out now. All games -70%
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Music plays an integral part in any game. It is the underlying current that sets the scene, the feeling, and the tone of a game. We might not always notice it when it’s there, but if you take it away, you will definitely feel that something is not right. And the wrong music at the wrong time can feel more awkward than asking the name of a person you’ve already met.
Today, we decided to release the music and soundtracks from our games and we bundled them in four distinct packages. Here’s a little breakdown of one another.

[u]Sherlock Holmes Classic Soundtrack[/u]
Venture into the mysterious world of the Sherlock Holmes adventures with this original soundtrack that captures the enigmatic mood of the classic games. A must-have for fans of the brilliant detective or thrilling orchestra music.

Includes soundtracks from Sherlock Holmes: The Mystery of the Mummy, Sherlock Holmes: The Silver Earring, Sherlock Holmes: The Awakened - Remastered Edition, Sherlock Holmes – Nemesis, Sherlock Holmes versus Jack the Ripper.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1250110/Sherlock_Holmes_Franchise_Classic_Soundtrack/

[u]Sherlock Holmes Modern Soundtrack[/u]
Discover the enchanting vibes of Sherlock Holmes games through this original soundtrack that includes music from the latest three adventures. Combining the iconic sounds of classical orchestra instruments with a modern electronic ambient style, this collection offers more than 50 tracks and is available in MP3 320 kbps.

Includes soundtracks from The Testament of Sherlock Holmes, Sherlock Holmes: Crimes and Punishments, Sherlock Holmes: The Devil's Daughter.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1252260/Sherlock_Holmes_Franchise_Modern_Soundtrack/
 
[u]Frogwares Classic Games Soundtrack[/u]
From energizing dance rhythms in 80 Days, to soul-stirring gothic tones of Dracula, this soundtrack offers a nostalgic look back at the Frogwares classic games. This is not just music – this is an insight into how it all began almost two decades ago.

This soundtrack includes music from Journey to the Center of the Earth, 80 Days, Dracula: Origin, Dracula: Love Kills, Sherlock Holmes and The Hound of The Baskervilles, Department 42: The Mystery of the Nine, Secret Missions: Mata Hari and the Kaiser's Submarines, Sherlock Holmes and the Mystery of the Frozen City, Sherlock Holmes and The Mystery of Osborne House, Secret Mission: The Forgotten Island

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1250710/Frogwares_Games_Classic_Soundtrack/

We know that music is a powerful thing, and we hope that if you had a great time with our games, that these musical pieces will bring back some of those memories. And if you haven’t played our games before, and you’re tempted to take the plunge, our games are now -70% off on Steam. If there ever was a time to try, it’s basically now. 


Regards,

Frogwares team

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Dracula: Love Kills
notes.content:
Dracula: Love Kills is Now Available on Steam and is 33% during the Steam Halloween Sale!

The Queen of Vampires emerges from the ashes of history, seeking to destroy the world of humans and rule over its ruins! No one, human or vampire, will stand in her way!
Count Dracula awakens, weakened and stripped of his powers after years of healing from his last battle with Dr. Van Helsing. He can not face his evil rival, the Queen, on his own…

To save the world, an uneasy alliance must be formed between the Prince of Darkness and his eternal enemy, Van Helsing. Will they overcome their hatred and stop the Queen? Or will this fragile alliance fail, condemning humanity to destruction? Only you can decide…

Join the legendary vampire count and his faithful servant Igor as the join forces with Dr. Van Helsing in a horrific adventure inspired by the work of Bram Stoker. Travel the world in search of the Knights of the Order of the Dragon and attempt to thwart the terrible plans of the dark Queen!
